subject: SIG intake: CAIQ + log retention questions
messages:
From: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@emberfield.io>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake: CAIQ + log retention questions

Hi Markus / Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick connect earlier. Attached is EmberField's SIG/CAIQ workbook (see EmberField_SIG_Questions_v1.xlsx) — we've filled the first pass and highlighted a few items we want to cover live:

- Log retention: we need to confirm retention windows and archival access for requestable logs (auth, API, model inference traces)
- Evidence for encryption at rest for model artifacts
- Network egress controls for private deployments

Can we schedule a 45-minute SIG intake call this week to walk through the highlighted rows and agree on evidence owners? Our security lead Igor and I are available: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT or Thu 1–4 PT.

Also: we may request a small sample bundle of recent logs (anonymized) to validate retention and rotation behavior.

Thanks,
Sara Brooks
Security Program Manager
EmberField

Attachments: EmberField_SIG_Questions_v1.xlsx
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@emberfield.io>
Cc: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: CAIQ + log retention questions

Sara — thanks for sending this over, appreciate the highlighted rows. Happy to take the intake — proposed slots look good.

We're available:
- Tue 15 Jul 10:30–11:15 PT
- Wed 16 Jul 11:00–11:45 PT

Agenda proposal (45m):
1) Quick intros & scope (5m)
2) Walk the top 10 highlighted CAIQ rows (20m)
3) Log retention & sample logs requirements (10m)
4) Action items & owners / timeline (10m)

Irene will cover retention/forensics logs; Aditya will handle engineering questions re: model artifact encryption and storage. Marissa will track evidence handoff and follow-ups.

Will you and Igor take Tue 10:30 PT? If not, we'll lock Wednesday.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Igor Petrov <igor@emberfield.io>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, sara.brooks@emberfield.io
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: CAIQ + log retention questions

Tue 10:30 PT works for us. I'll join with the engineer who owns retention (cc'd on follow-up if needed).

Two items to prep on our side:
- We will need a short mapping of which CAIQ questions you consider "covered by SOC2" vs "evidence required"
- A sample manifest of what the anonymized logs will look like (fields, timestamps, identifiers removed)

Thanks,
Igor
From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@emberfield.io>, Igor Petrov <igor@emberfield.io>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SIG intake: CAIQ + log retention questions — meeting notes and owners

Thanks everyone for a productive call — quick notes from the intake and agreed owners:

Meeting summary (15 Jul 2025, 10:30 PT):
- Scope: CAIQ baseline + targeted SIG rows for log/retention, encryption, and private deployment network controls.
- Outcome: Redwood will provide a CAIQ mapping sheet with a SOC2 column indicating which controls are covered by our SOC2 report, plus a list of remaining evidence items.

Action items and owners:
- Redwood: Provide CAIQ mapping (redwood-caiq-mapping.xlsx) — owner: Irene — due 2025-07-16 EOD
- Redwood: Export sample anonymized logs (auth + inference request metadata) — owner: Aditya — small tarball with manifest (sample-logs-2025-06.tar.gz) — due 2025-07-16 5pm PT
- Redwood: Redacted retention policy and retention-by-log-type summary (retention_policy_summary.pdf) — owner: Markus / Marissa — due 2025-07-16 EOD
- EmberField: Confirm any additional legal/archival constraints and provide an internal contact for log ingestion questions — owner: Igor — due 2025-07-17

Notes on logs: Aditya confirmed logs will be anonymized; timestamps preserved, user identifiers replaced with hashed ids; no PII to be included. Tarball will include a README describing fields.

Next steps: I'll upload the CAIQ mapping and policy summary to the shared Drive folder and post the HubSpot link. Markus / Marissa will follow up on evidence delivery.

— Irene
Information Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-caiq-mapping.xlsx (draft)
From: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@emberfield.io>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Igor Petrov <igor@emberfield.io>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: CAIQ + log retention questions — confirmation

Thanks Irene — that looks good. A couple quick clarifying Qs from EmberField after the call:

1) For the sample logs, can you confirm retention (originals) — i.e. how long are raw auth logs kept before rotation? We only need the policy window (e.g., 90 days hot, 12 months archived) not raw data.
2) For network egress controls on private deployments: does Redwood provide an allowlist-based outbound policy by default, or is that customer-configured?

If you could add short answers to the mapping sheet, we can mark which items are closed.

Sara
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@emberfield.io>, Igor Petrov <igor@emberfield.io>
Cc: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: CAIQ + log retention questions — evidence handoff

Sara / Igor — attaching the artifacts we discussed. Links and attachments below.

Provided artifacts (attached / uploaded):
- redwood-caiq-mapping.xlsx (draft, SOC2 coverage column added)
- retention_policy_summary.pdf (policy windows by log type)
- sample-logs-2025-06.tar.gz (anonymized sample + README)

Quick answers to your clarifying Qs:
- Raw auth logs: hot retention is 90 days; archive retention for compliance support is 24 months (archived, searchable via ticketed access).
- Private deployments: outbound egress is allowlist-based by default in our VPC package; customer-managed allowlist controls are provided and documented — see mapping sheet network controls column for details.

HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/REDW-7890
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_emberfield-sig

Action owners recap:
- Irene: finalize CAIQ mapping (ETA EOD today)
- Aditya: confirm tarball upload to secure transfer (SFTP link) and send SFTP link to EmberField (ETA 5pm PT)
- Marissa/Markus: follow up on any remaining evidence requests and close items in HubSpot.

If anything else pops up, flag it on the HubSpot ticket and we'll triage.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-caiq-mapping.xlsx, retention_policy_summary.pdf, sample-logs-2025-06.tar.gz
